---
title: "GAM Areal"
format: pdf
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(mgcv)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(terra)
```

```{r}
data_sf = st_read("Counties/shapefiles/lungcancer.shp")
map <- ne_countries(type = "countries",
                    country = "Ireland",
                    scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")

# 1. Assign EPSG:2157 if not already set
st_crs(data_sf) <- 2157
```

```{r}
yr = 2022
data_year = data_sf |> filter(Year == yr)

# 2. Transform to WGS84 (lat/lon)
data_year_transformed <- st_transform(data_year, crs = 4326)

# 3. Extract the lat/lon from geometry
centroids <- st_centroid(data_year_transformed)
```

```{r}
mapview(centroids, zcol = "value")
```

```{r}
latlon = st_coordinates(centroids)
gam_data = data.frame(value = centroids$value, Longitude = latlon[,"X"], Latitude = latlon[,"Y"])
gam_data = gam_data |> mutate(
        weight = (value - min(value, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(value, na.rm = TRUE) - min(value, na.rm = TRUE)) + 1e-4
      )
K = length(unique(paste(gam_data$Latitude, gam_data$Longitude)))

model = mgcv::gam(value ~ s(Latitude, Longitude, bs="tp", k = K), 
                      data = gam_data, 
                      weights = weight,
                      family = "gaussian",  # Fixed typo
                      method = "REML")

preds = gam_data |> dplyr::select(Longitude, Latitude)
preds$value = predict(model, newdata = preds)
data_year$preds = preds$value
data_year$preds = as.vector(data_year$preds)
data_year = data_year |> dplyr::select(geometry, preds)

st_write(data_year, "areal_outputs/gam/lungcancer_predictions.shp", delete_layer = TRUE)

mapview(data_year, zcol = "preds")
```

```{r}
# Create prediction grid
grid <- terra::rast(map, nrows = 200, ncols = 200)
xy <- terra::xyFromCell(grid, 1:ncell(grid))
dp <- st_as_sf(as.data.frame(xy), coords = c("x", "y"),
               crs = st_crs(map))

# Filter points within map boundaries
dp <- st_filter(dp, map)
pred_coords = st_coordinates(dp)

# Create prediction dataframe
grid_df = as.data.frame(pred_coords)
names(grid_df) = c("Longitude", "Latitude")  # This is correct

# Make predictions
grid_df$value <- predict(model, newdata = grid_df)
r <- rast(grid_df[, c("Longitude", "Latitude", "value")], type="xyz")
crs(r) <- "EPSG:4326"
mapview(r)
```
